obligations.text: NameSpace defaults to the namespace being installed into (whether IPM should take over or delete applications it did not create is open).
obligations.cases: NameSpace omitted, install into USER vs USER2
obligations.basis: new:iteration-68
obligations.gap: iteration61 names ResourceProcessor/WebApplication.cls::CopyAttributes as the NameSpace default, but App/Decl carry no namespace. Contrast: install into USER2 without NameSpace gives NameSpace=USER2.

obligations.text: Attribute values are expanded like other resource attributes, so {$mgrdir} becomes the manager directory.
obligations.cases: attribute with {$mgrdir} vs literal
obligations.basis: new:iteration-68
obligations.gap: attr_evaluator.rs covers the evaluator, but no model connects WebApplication.cls::CopyAttributes evaluating each declared attribute to the app property written. Contrast: Path="{$mgrdir}x" gives the manager directory path in Security.Applications.

obligations.text: Loading again writes only the attributes still declared, so a removed attribute keeps its previous value.

obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/web-applications.g5.md metadata module.webapp (iter5 webapp.rs, iter61 webappphases.rs) (control removed-attribute-cleared rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G7): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G7-m66)

obligations.text: compile -only does not touch the application.
obligations.cases: compile -only after a manual edit
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/web-applications.g5.md metadata module.webapp (iter5 webapp.rs, iter61 webappphases.rs) (control compile-resets rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G7): partial, support inspection
obligations.gap: Rule 4a (iteration-72): compile_only(s) = s writes the outcome down; neither -only phase selection nor the processor phase filter (OnBeforePhase acts on Activate/Configure and Clean/Unconfigure) is modelled, so a compile that touched the app has no counterpart

obligations.text: Both Activate and Configure update the application.
obligations.cases: Configure-only vs Activate run
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/web-applications.g5.md metadata module.webapp (iter5 webapp.rs, iter61 webappphases.rs)
obligations.gap: load() models the Activate update only. Configure is not a distinct case, so a processor updating only on Activate satisfies the model. Reader: WebApplication.cls::OnBeforePhase for Configure.

parent.entailment: The parent owns create, adopt, delete, reinstall, duplicate refusal, NameSpace and attribute handling (#1-#11). The children add failure, upgrade and validation outcomes and do not entail parent obligations. No composition is credited.

units.B1: excluded: working assumption to disclose the as-built orphan; restates P1 with no further outcome

obligations.text: As built (C:D26), upgrading to a version whose manifest no longer declares a web application leaves it in place, and a later uninstall deletes only applications the installed version declares, so the old application remains.
obligations.cases: upgrade dropping the declaration then uninstall vs no upgrade
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/web-applications.g5.md metadata module.webapp.upgrade (control upgrade-removes-app rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G7): partial, support inspection (mutations G7-m68)
obligations.note: Upgrade is modeled as the identity on applications, a transcription of ExecutePhases/%Clean acting only on the installed manifest. The update command from a registry was not run.
obligations.gap: Rule 4a (iteration-72): the upgrade step is written as the identity, so how update/install treats a resource dropped from the new manifest is not modelled; that the installed version no longer declares the app is the input None; only the uninstall half (deletes only declared names) is computed

obligations.text: As built (C:D23), an attribute that is not a web application property is passed through without an error, because the lifecycle Validate step never calls the processor check.
obligations.cases: unknown attribute vs none
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/web-applications.g5.md metadata module.webapp.validation (control validate-dispatches rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G7): partial, support inspection
obligations.note: The dispatch decision is a transcribed constant (Lifecycle/Base.cls::%Validate returns OK without dispatching).
obligations.gap: Rule 4a (iteration-72): the as-built pass-through rests on the constant validate_dispatches() = false; the lifecycle %Validate dispatch (Lifecycle/Base.cls) that skips the processor OnPhase("Validate") check is not modelled

obligations.text: The unknown attribute has no effect on the application.
obligations.cases: NoSuchProperty="1" vs absent
obligations.basis: new:iteration-68
obligations.gap: iteration5 and iteration61 declarations carry only known properties, so an unknown attribute's effect is not represented (native W9 only). Reader: Security.Applications.Get after Activate.

obligations.text: Updating an existing web app calls Modify only when a declared value differs from its old value; an absent old property reads as empty, so a declared empty value for it is not a change.
obligations.cases: equal, changed, and empty-on-absent declared values
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/web-applications.g5.md metadata module.webapp.provider-status (iter7 inputs.rs differs, app_status) (controls missing-empty-is-change, modify-always-call rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G7): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G7-m69)

obligations.text: With no differing value the phase succeeds without Modify; with a differing value a returned Modify failure becomes a failed phase status.
obligations.cases: no diff vs diff with Modify failure vs success
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/web-applications.g5.md metadata module.webapp.provider-status (iter7 inputs.rs differs, app_status) (control modify-swallow-failure rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G7): full, support mutation-checked (mutations G7-m70)

obligations.text: A failed Get or Create also fails the phase.
obligations.cases: Get failure; Create failure for a new app
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/web-applications.g5.md metadata module.webapp.provider-status (iter7 inputs.rs differs, app_status)
obligations.gap: iteration61 load fails on a provider-rejected declaration (control invalid-kept), but Get failure is not a case and app_status has no Get/Create input. Reader: WebApplication.cls::CreateOrUpdateWebApp status into Storage/Module.cls::ExecutePhases.

obligations.text: Switching into %SYS for the provider call restores the caller's namespace on return or error (provider failure does not promise no partial changes).
obligations.cases: provider success vs error
obligations.basis: new:iteration-68
obligations.gap: No formal rule represents the namespace switch. Contrast: a Modify error leaves $namespace equal to the caller's.

obligations.text: The application is created before the module's later steps; if the install then fails inside its transaction, the rollback also removes the application.
obligations.cases: failure after Activate with vs without transaction
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/web-applications.g5.md metadata module.webapp.failure (iter5 webapp.rs failed_after_activate, control transaction-keeps-app rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G7): partial, support inspection
obligations.note: Rollback of the %SYS write is a native-qualified premise of the model.
obligations.gap: Rule 4a (iteration-72): rollback is a two-row outcome table on the transaction flag; the %SYS Security.Applications write inside the load transaction and TROLLBACK are not modelled, so the removal is written down, not derived

obligations.text: With -DNoTransaction=1, the application and the module record both stay after the failure.
obligations.cases: same failure without transaction
obligations.basis: reused:.g5/ontology/features/web-applications.g5.md metadata module.webapp.failure (iter5 webapp.rs failed_after_activate, control transaction-keeps-app rejected); iteration-72 rule-4a re-audit (G7): partial, support inspection
obligations.gap: Rule 4a (iteration-72): same outcome table: with -DNoTransaction=1 the kept application and module record are table entries, not derived from the absence of a transaction around the writes

obligations.text: Web-app resources are configuration and are marked handled during export, so their paths are not exported as database documents.

obligations.gap: webapp_export_handled is the constant true and package_app ignores has_source_document, so no model observes which documents the archive contains. Reader: WebApplication.cls::OnExportItem into Lifecycle/Base.cls::ExportSingleModule.

obligations.text: Publishing preserves web-app declarations in the package.

obligations.text: As built (C:D61), updating an existing application writes every property the processor knows, so undeclared properties set by an administrator return to processor defaults (WebApplication keeps them, module.webapp#3).
